translated:
Here, on the outskirts of Coriander Village,
the orb was enshrined...

...that was the last record
remaining in Dipan.

Back then it was probably
more prosperous.
The documents were from over 500 years ago.
Amazing that such a thing survived.

Dipan was originally a nation founded by a
branch of the Orb Guardian clan.
...It is the natural education of a loyal retainer.
The past is something that weathers away.
